recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-16992 unless a future work group decision changes the defaultValue policy for logical models or FHIR-defined StructureDefinitions.

Its final Persuasive with Modification resolution was to add a constraint ensuring default values only exist in non-FHIR content, with a Jira comment saying the work was already done under another task.

additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes the ElementDefinition type page and StructureDefinition resource. Current StructureDefinition constraints sdf-21 and sdf-22 prohibit default values in FHIR Specification models and in constraints/profiles, while ElementDefinition narrative still allows defaultValue for logical models. Related FHIR-16934 is already represented on the combined branch.
